name: io.github.ShinjukuStaition/shinjuku-mcp
title: Shinjuku Shielded
description: Private x402 payments on Solana: shield, pay, and unshield USDC under caps you set.

packageArguments.description: The wallet command that runs the MCP server on stdio.

packageArguments.name: --max-payment
packageArguments.description: The most one payment may cost, in atomic USDC (50000 = 0.05 USDC). The server does not start without it.

packageArguments.name: --max-session
packageArguments.description: The most this server process may pay in total, in atomic USDC. At least --max-payment.

packageArguments.name: --pool
packageArguments.description: The shielded pool. The wallet file is $SHIELDED_WALLET_HOME/<pool>/wallet.json.

packageArguments.name: --memo-service
packageArguments.description: The facilitator that serves the encrypted memos. Its RPC relay serves reads without --rpc-file.

packageArguments.name: --passphrase-file
packageArguments.description: Absolute path of a private file that holds the wallet passphrase. Without it, SHIELDED_WALLET_PASSPHRASE.

packageArguments.name: --proof-tools
packageArguments.description: Absolute path of proof-tools.json. Turns wallet_shield on and is needed to pay shielded-exact.

packageArguments.name: --exit-proof-tools
packageArguments.description: Absolute path of exit-proof-tools.json. With --profile and --proof-tools, turns wallet_unshield on.

packageArguments.name: --profile
packageArguments.description: Absolute path of public-profile.json (the facilitator's public profile). Needed for wallet_unshield.

packageArguments.name: --unshield-to
packageArguments.description: A public Solana address that wallet_unshield sends to with no confirmation. Never the wallet's own key.

packageArguments.name: --max-unshield
packageArguments.description: The most one wallet_unshield call, and this process in total, may send, in atomic USDC.

packageArguments.name: --max-shield
packageArguments.description: The most one wallet_shield call, and this process in total, may move, in atomic USDC.

packageArguments.name: --max-per-host-day
packageArguments.description: The most one seller host may receive in 24 hours, in atomic USDC.

packageArguments.name: --allow-host
packageArguments.description: Pay only this seller host (host or host:port).

packageArguments.name: --rpc-file
packageArguments.description: Absolute path of a private file with your own Solana RPC URL. Without it, reads go to the facilitator relay.

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDED_WALLET_HOME
environmentVariables.description: The private folder that holds the encrypted wallet (the folder that init used).

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDED_WALLET_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: The wallet passphrase, if you do not use --passphrase-file.
